title: callicarpa serrulata
intro: Callicarpa serrulata, commonly known as the Purple Trumpet Vine, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Callicarpa serrulata include reducing fever, treating skin conditions, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
